5.t: Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them, Lord of every sunrise.

6.t: We have adorned the lowest heaven with stars,

7.t: and made them a safeguard against every rebellious devil:

8.t: they cannot eavesdrop on the Higher Assembly––pelted from every side,

9.t: driven away, they will have perpetual torment––

10.t: if any [of them] stealthily snatches away a fragment, he will be pursued by a piercing flame.

11.t: So [Prophet], ask the disbelievers: is it harder to create them than other beings We have created? We created them from sticky clay.

13.t: take no heed when they are warned,

14.t: and resort to ridicule when they see a sign,

15.t: saying, ‘This is no more than blatant sorcery.’

16.t: ‘What! After we have died and become dust and bones, shall we really be raised up again,

18.t: Say, ‘Yes indeed, and you will be humiliated.’

19.t: Just one blast and––lo and behold!––they will look

20.t: and say, ‘Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgement.’

21.t: [It will be said], ‘This is the Day of Decision, which you used to deny.

22.t: [Angels], gather together those who did wrong, and others like them, as well as whatever they worshipped

23.t: beside God, lead them all to the path of Hell,

25.t: “Why do you not support each other now?” ’––

26.t: no indeed! They will be in complete submission on that Day––

27.t: and they will turn on one another accusingly.

28.t: They will say, ‘You came to us from a position of power.’

29.t: They will say, ‘No! It was you who would not believe-

30.t: we had no power over you- and you were already exceeding all limits.

31.t: Our Lord’s sentence on us is just and we must all taste the punishment.

32.t: We led you astray as we ourselves were astray.’

33.t: On that Day they will all share the torment:

34.t: this is how We deal with the guilty.

35.t: Whenever it was said to them, ‘There is no deity but God,’ they became arrogant,

36.t: and said, ‘Are we to forsake our gods for a mad poet?’

37.t: ‘No: he brought the truth and confirmed the earlier messengers;

38.t: you will taste the painful torment,

39.t: and be repaid only according to your deeds.’

44.t: seated on couches, facing one another.

45.t: A drink will be passed round among them from a flowing spring:

46.t: white, delicious to those who taste it,

48.t: With them will be spouses- modest of gaze and beautiful of eye-

50.t: They will turn to one another with questions:

51.t: one will say, ‘I had a close companion on earth

52.t: who used to ask me, “Do you really believe that

53.t: after we die and become dust and bone, we shall be brought for judgement?”’

54.t: Then he will say, ‘Shall we look for him?’

55.t: He will look down and see him in the midst of the Fire,

56.t: and say to him, ‘By God, you almost brought me to ruin!

57.t: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I too would have been taken to Hell.’

58.t: Then he will say [to his blessed companions], ‘Are we never to die again after our earlier death?

60.t: This truly is the supreme triumph!’

61.t: Everyone should strive to attain this.

62.t: Is this the better welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum,

63.t: which we have made a test for the evildoers?

64.t: This tree grows in the heart of the blazing Fire,

65.t: and its fruits are like devils’ heads.

66.t: They will fill their bellies eating from it;

67.t: then drink scalding water on top of it;

68.t: then return to the blazing Fire.

70.t: and rushed to follow in their footsteps- before the disbelievers [of Mecca],

71.t: most men in the past went astray,

72.t: even though We sent messengers to warn them.

73.t: See how those who were warned met their end!

74.t: Not so the true servants of God.

75.t: Noah cried to Us, and how excellent was Our response!

76.t: We saved him and his people from great distress,

77.t: We let his offspring remain on the earth,

78.t: We let him be praised by later generations:

79.t: ‘Peace be upon Noah among all the nations!’

80.t: This is how We reward those who do good:

81.t: he was truly one of Our faithful servants.

83.t: Abraham was of the same faith:

84.t: he came to his Lord with a devoted heart.

85.t: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are you worshipping?

86.t: How can you choose false gods instead of the true God?

87.t: So what is your opinion about the Lord of all the Worlds?’

88.t: then he looked up to the stars.

90.t: so [his people] turned away from him and left.

91.t: He turned to their gods and said, ‘Do you not eat?

93.t: then he turned and struck them with his right arm.

95.t: but he said, ‘How can you worship things you carve with your own hands,

96.t: when it is God who has created you and all your handiwork?’

97.t: They said, ‘Build a pyre and throw him into the blazing fire.’

98.t: They wanted to harm him, but We humiliated them.

99.t: He said, ‘I will go to my Lord: He is sure to guide me.

100.t: Lord, grant me a righteous son,’

101.t: so We gave him the good news that he would have a patient son.

102.t: When the boy was old enough to work with his father, Abraham said, ‘My son, I have seen myself sacrificing you in a dream. What do you think?’ He said, ‘Father, do as you are commanded and, God willing, you will find me steadfast.’

103.t: When they had both submitted to God, and he had laid his son down on the side of his face,

105.t: you have fulfilled the dream.’ This is how We reward those who do good-

106.t: it was a test to prove [their true characters]-

107.t: We ransomed his son with a momentous sacrifice,

108.t: and We let him be praised by succeeding generations:

110.t: This is how We reward those who do good:

111.t: truly he was one of Our faithful servants.

112.t: We gave Abraham the good news of Isaac- a prophet and a righteous man-

113.t: and blessed him and Isaac too: some of their offspring were good, but some clearly wronged themselves.

114.t: We also bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron:

115.t: We saved them and their people from great distress;

116.t: We helped them, so they were the ones to succeed;

117.t: We gave them the Scripture that makes things clear;

118.t: We guided them to the right path;

119.t: We let them be praised by succeeding generations:

121.t: This is how We reward those who do good:

122.t: truly they were among Our faithful servants.

123.t: Elijah too was one of the messengers.

124.t: He said to his people, ‘Have you no fear of God?

125.t: How can you invoke Baal and forsake the Most Gracious Creator,

126.t: God, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?’

127.t: but they rejected him. They will be brought to punishment as a consequence;

128.t: not so the true servants of God.

129.t: We let him be praised by succeeding generations:

131.t: This is how We reward those who do good:

132.t: truly he was one of Our faithful servants.

133.t: Lot was also one of the messengers.

134.t: We saved him and all his family-

135.t: except for an old woman who stayed behind-

137.t: You [people] pass by their ruins morning

138.t: and night: will you not take heed?

139.t: Jonah too was one of the messengers.

140.t: He fled to the overloaded ship.

141.t: They cast lots, he suffered defeat,

142.t: and a great fish swallowed him, for he had committed blameworthy acts.

143.t: If he had not been one of those who glorified God,

144.t: he would have stayed in its belly until the Day when all are raised up,

145.t: but We cast him out, sick, on to a barren shore,

146.t: and made a gourd tree grow above him.

147.t: We sent him to a hundred thousand people or more.

148.t: They believed, so We let them live out their lives.

149.t: Now [Muhammad], ask the disbelievers: is it true that your Lord has daughters, while they choose sons for themselves?

150.t: Did We create the angels as females while they were watching?

151.t: No indeed! It is one of their lies when they say,

153.t: Did He truly choose daughters in preference to sons?

154.t: What is the matter with you? How do you form your judgements?

156.t: Do you perhaps have clear authority?

157.t: Bring your scriptures, if you are telling the truth.

158.t: They claim that He has kinship with the jinn, yet the jinn themselves know that they will be brought before Him.

159.t: God is far above what they attribute to Him-

160.t: the true servants of God do not do such things-

161.t: and neither you nor what you worship

162.t: can lure away from God any

163.t: except those who will burn in Hell.

164.t: [The angels say], ‘Every single one of us has his appointed place:

168.t: ‘If only we had a scripture like previous people,

169.t: we would be true servants of God,’

170.t: yet now they reject [the Quran]. They will soon realize.

171.t: Our word has already been given to Our servants the messengers:

172.t: it is they who will be helped,

173.t: and the ones who support Our cause will be the winners.

174.t: So [Prophet] turn away from the disbelievers for a while.

175.t: Watch them: they will soon see.

176.t: Do they really wish to hasten Our punishment?

177.t: When it descends on their courtyards, how ter-rible that morning will be for those who were warned!

178.t: [Prophet], turn away from the disbelievers for a while.

179.t: Watch them: they will soon see.

180.t: Your Lord, the Lord of Glory, is far above what they attribute to Him.

182.t: and praise be to God the Lord of all the Worlds.
